text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who brilliantly claimed victory in 
the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, was Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With all eyes in the venue upon her, she 
proudly proclaims that this is where she 
belongs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is said that in the stands, a small, 
red-haired girl was moved to tears by that 
run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the defeated Winning Ticket 
swore firmly that she wouldn't lose on the 
next stage, the Japanese Derby.
